resources.string: Previews for files on cloud and network storages

When on, the picture view downloads pictures and documents of a cloud or network storage into the cache of this phone (up to the size you choose) to draw their preview. Only visible tiles are loaded. Encrypted vaults are never previewed. Off by default to save data and for privacy.
Suggested: 2 MB. Larger files keep the coloured type tile.
Only on Wi-Fi or unmetered networks
No preview downloads on mobile data or other metered connections.
